EX series

EX Trainer Kit 2 Minun

Released March 1, 2006 · 12 cards

EX Trainer Kit 2 Minun is a Pokémon TCG expansion in the EX series, released in English on March 1, 2006. It has 12 cards. It includes 7 Pokémon, 3 Trainer and 2 Energy cards, and is not legal in Standard or Expanded.

Illustrators

7 illustrators worked on EX Trainer Kit 2 Minun. Most cards: Ken Sugimori (3), Midori Harada (2), Kai Ishikawa (1), Katsura Tabata (1), Keiji Kinebuchi (1), Kouki Saitou (1), Naoyo Kimura (1).
